tools_problematic.problem: Dependent bootstrap commands raced, and later overlapping run/build/validation commands contended for NuGet and XAML compiler files.

tool_limitations.limitation: It inventoried only files physically below -Source and omitted authored Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content items linked from the UWP project.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Resolve common MSBuild properties and copy linked project items to their Link destinations before triage.

tool_limitations.limitation: It searched only bin\x64\Debug or bin\win-x64\Debug, while a normal dotnet build emitted bin\Debug\<tfm>\win-x64.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Search both platform-qualified and standard SDK-style Debug output roots.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build guidance
doc_errors.correct: Use synchronous native dotnet build; WinApp CLI is used for launch/identity, not compilation.

doc_errors.wrong: The generated map was presented as a complete source inventory even when the UWP csproj linked authored files outside -Source.
doc_errors.correct: Bootstrap must include linked project items before claiming mapping completeness.

special_apis.special_handling: Initialize the picker with the WinUI window HWND before PickSingleFileAsync.
The packaged desktop migration retained SetImageFileAsync/GetImageStream behavior; package identity and a desktop-compatible manifest were required.

errors_encountered.error: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1: Target not found; Test-Path returned False.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check were issued concurrently even though bootstrap depends on scaffold completion.
errors_encountered.fix: Waited for dotnet new to finish, reran bootstrap, then consumed its artifacts.

errors_encountered.error: winapp build: unrecognized command or argument 'build'.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill documented a command absent from the installed WinApp CLI.
The reconstructed shared shell resolved an unqualified priority enum to the wrong namespace.
A shared ResourceDictionary omitted by bootstrap was manually recreated as a local XAML class instead of merged by URI.

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909/WMC1111 could not resolve local:Scenario for x:Bind; WMC9999 followed.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Manual reconstruction of omitted shared XAML introduced a compiled-binding type-resolution failure.
errors_encountered.fix: Used runtime Binding for the scenario title; the internal compiler error disappeared with the root XAML errors.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The SDK-style project already includes local XAML pages implicitly; the agent added a redundant explicit Page item while repairing omitted shared styles.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch status=unavailable: no build output under bin\x64\Debug.
errors_encountered.root_cause: The script did not search the standard unqualified dotnet build output under bin\Debug.
errors_encountered.fix: The agent later produced a platform-qualified build; the skill script was improved to search both layouts.

errors_encountered.error: Validator build failed with 'Cannot create a file when that file already exists' and locked input.json.
errors_encountered.root_cause: dotnet run, a manual build, and validation rebuilds overlapped against the same project artifacts.
errors_encountered.fix: Stopped the long-running command/build processes and reran validation in isolation.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The agent searched generated obj XAML/code and SharedContent, then manually rebuilt the shell, styles, and assets.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Eight turns before the first build.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap copied only three local files and ignored fourteen linked authored project items.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Recovered shared sources and assets from sibling directories/generated metadata and recreated the WinUI shell.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Import linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content project items during bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two build-fix cycles handled dispatcher, resource dictionary, binding, and duplicate Page errors.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Manual reconstruction of files omitted from the migration inventory introduced secondary C#/XAML mistakes.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Qualified the enum, changed binding strategy, merged the dictionary by URI, and removed the duplicate item.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Preserve linked authored files and their Link paths mechanically instead of reconstructing them.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Validation failed three times around restore/XAML intermediate collisions before passing.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Build, run, and validator commands were started concurrently against shared obj output.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Stopped competing processes and ran validation alone.

missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The generated-source investigation and manual recreation of the shared shell, resource dictionary, and assets.
